v.text: The Company will be participating in the analyst/institutional investor conferences/meetings on 18th and 19th November 2026 as per enclosed schedule.
v.summary: Asian Paints Limited has intimated the schedule of analyst and institutional investor meetings pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations 2015. The company representatives will participate in the Morgan Stanley Twenty-Fifth Annual Asia Pacific Summit in Singapore from Wednesday 18th November 2026 to Thursday 19th November 2026 starting at 9:30 a.m. SGT onwards. This includes one-on-one and group meetings. Additionally, one-on-one meetings with BlackRock are scheduled for Thursday 19th November 2026 at 1:45 p.m. SGT onwards in Singapore. The schedule may change due to exigencies. No unpublished price sensitive information will be shared during these conferences or meetings. The CFO and Company Secretary R J Jeyamurugan signed the communication on 9th November 2026.
